set.body:
Source: 2026-07-25 review finding 11b.

Problem:
BatchPlanner.resources (core/Batch.scala:522-530) computes multiply("cpusPerAllocation", perTask.cpus, slots) and then discards it whenever tasks != 1 (:525 selects perTask.cpus for the gang case). The discarded computation can still fail with BatchPlanFailure.ResourceOverflow on a value nothing uses, so a legal gang shape can be rejected for an overflow in a dead quantity.

Acceptance:
- The per-allocation CPU product is computed only on the path that consumes it.
- Overflow reporting for the paths that do consume it is unchanged.
- A test compiles a gang plan whose (cpus * tasksPerNode) product would overflow Int and asserts it succeeds.
set.title: P6f.39: Remove the unused CPU product from gang planning
